调研：模拟/射频（RFIC）芯片设计的免费开源 EDA 工具、社区与最佳实践，重点是 Wi-Fi 7（802.11be）射频发射机（TX）链路设计。当前时间 2026 年 10 月，请优先采用近两年（2024-2026）的信息。

请覆盖以下子问题：
1. 免费开源 EDA 工具全景（截至 2026）：
   - 电路仿真：SPICE 类（ngspice、Xyce、Qucs/Qucs-S 等）对 RFIC 的适用性与局限；Verilog-A 建模支持。
   - 版图与 PDK：Magic、KLayout、OpenLane 等开源流程；开源 PDK 生态（SkyWater sky130、GF180MCU、IHP SG13G2 SiGe BiCMOS 等）对射频设计的支持程度（器件 fT/fmax、RF 电感/无源器件模型）。
   - 电磁仿真：openEMS、Elmer FEM、MEEP 等对射频无源件（电感/巴伦/匹配网络/传输线）的实用性。
   - 系统级/行为级：Python 生态（scikit-rf、numpy/scipy 自建链路仿真、gdsfactory 等）在 RF 链路预算与行为级建模的角色。
   - 商业工具的免费/学术资源（Keysight ADS、Cadence、NI AWR 的学术版/试用）作对比参照。
2. 社区：活跃的开源 EDA/RFIC 社区（论坛、GitHub 组织、Discord/Slack、ORConf 等会议）、中文社区；去哪里提问、找 PDK 与开源 IP。
3. 优秀实践：用开源工具流完成 RFIC/无线收发机设计的有名案例（论文、GitHub 项目、开源 tapeout，如 TinyTapeout/chipIgnite/IHP Open PDK 设计竞赛中的射频项目）；行为级+晶体管级混合验证流程的最佳实践；WiFi/802.11 收发机的开源实现代表项目。
4. Wi-Fi 7（802.11be）TX 射频设计业界最新进展（2024-2026）：主流商用方案（高通/博通/联发科/MaxLinear 等）的射频架构趋势（直接变频、DPLL、数字预失真 DPD、集成度）；关键指标演进（4096-QAM 的 EVM 要求、320MHz 带宽、6GHz 频段、MLO 对射频前端的要求）；学术前沿（ISSCC/JSSC 上 802.11be 收发机代表性工作）。
5. 落地建议：对一个已完成行为级链路仿真（Python：EVM/SEM/ACLR/PVT 蒙特卡洛）、下一步要走向晶体管级设计的 Wi-Fi7 TX ASIC 小组，推荐的开源工具链组合与学习路径、可复用资源。

args.text: 开源 EDA/RFIC 生态实测结论（2026-10-15 检索验证）：(1) IHP-Open-PDK（github.com/IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK）为 130nm BiCMOS 开源 PDK，定位 Analog/Mixed-Signal/RF，Apache 2.0，SG13G2 节点，2026-09-01 未发布版 CHANGELOG 新增大量 RF 内容：RF MOSFET PyCells、MoM 电容 PCell（cap_cmomf/cap_mom/cap_cmimi）、rfcmim、KLayout 电感金属栈可配置、Magic LVS 电感识别、肖特基二极管 SBD、HBT 测试结构 GDS、gds2palace 子模块（AWS Palace EM 提取，兼容 scikit-rf 2.0）；官方文档 ihp-open-pdk-docs.readthedocs.io 自述仍为 preview/alpha，不可用于生产。器件 fT/fmax 具体数值未见于 README/docs 首页（勿凭记忆写 350GHz）。(2) IIC-OSIC-TOOLS（github.com/iic-jku/IIC-OSIC-TOOLS，JKU）Docker 一体化镜像支持 SKY130/GF180/IHP130 模数混合流，Ubuntu 24.04，2025.01 起。 (3) Qucs-S（ra3xdh.github.io）最新稳定版 26.1.1，26.1.0 于 2026-04-09 发布，2024-2026 保持月度级更新，后端支持 ngspice/Xyce/QucsatorRF/SpiceOpus，GitHub discussions 为支持论坛。(4) ngspice 官网 ngspice.sourceforge.io 被 Cloudflare 拦截无法直读；SourceForge 活动流（2026-10-15）显示开发线为 pre-master-48、社区活跃（Dietmar Warning 等）。(5) openEMS（github.com/thliebig/openEMS-Project）为 FDTD 电磁求解器，Octave/Matlab+Python 接口，官网 openems.de 多次抓取失败（GitHub Pages 404/被拦），README 自述文档站 docs.openEMS.de。(6) 开源 RF tapeout 案例：Patrick Fath "Towards a practical open source RF SoC design flow: Lessons from a 40 GHz tapeout in IHP SG13G2"（Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21508491，2026-07-06），流程 IIC-OSIC-TOOLS+Xschem+ngspice/Xyce+KLayout，post-layout 0.15–44.7GHz、-56dBm、62dB 动态范围，指出开源生态最大缺口=寄生提取流程未完全验证。(7) Efabless 2025 年倒闭（搜狐 m.sohu.com/a/866090434_121948415，曾与 50 学术机构合作、80 项商业设计），波及 TinyTapeout；TinyTapeout 2025-08-28 宣布回归（东方财富 caifuhao），改用 LibreLane 后端，当前提供 SKY26d/GF26c 班车 + IHP/SKY/GF 模板（含 SKY Analog 模拟模板）+ Discord 社区。(8) scikit-rf（scikit-rf.readthedocs.io）BSD 协议 RF/Microwave Python 库，含 Circuit/Calibration/De-embedding/Vector Fitting/Virtual Instruments，2026 仍在持续被引用。(9) openwifi（github.com/open-sdr/openwifi）为 SDR 基带全栈 802.11a/g/n 开源实现（FPGA+AD9361，AGPLv3 双许可，70MHz–6GHz 频率范围 app note），非 ASIC RF。

# 模拟/RFIC 开源 EDA 工具、社区与 Wi-Fi 7 TX 设计调研报告

**检索时间：2026-10-15（UTC）。** 方法说明：本次共约 37 次工具调用（官网/GitHub/readthedocs 直接抓取 + OpenAlex 学术库 + 中英文搜索引擎交叉）。部分目标站点（ngspice.sourceforge.io 官网首页、openems.de 主站）被 Cloudflare 拦截或 404，已改用 SourceForge 活动流与 GitHub 仓库页作为一手替代来源；凡未能读到正文的信息，下文均明确标注「未确认」。搜索过程中的数字（如各仓库 star/版本号）均以工具实际返回为准。

---

## 1. 免费开源 EDA 工具全景（截至 2026-10）

### 1.1 电路仿真：SPICE 类

**【事实】**
- **ngspice**：官网（ngspice.sourceforge.io）被 Cloudflare 拦截无法直读；但 SourceForge 官方活动流（2026-10-15 抓取）显示项目**极活跃**：开发线已到 `pre-master-48`（git master 提交 75f22a99，2026-10-14），核心维护者 Dietmar Warning 当天仍在 ngspice-users 论坛回复 agauss/蒙特卡洛相关 bug。IHP Open PDK 官方 README 将 ngspice 列为**受支持仿真器**（附官方下载页链接）。
- **Xyce**（Sandia 国家实验室）：同样被 IHP PDK README 列为受支持仿真器，并出现在 IIC-OSIC-TOOLS 工具清单中。
- **Qucs-S**：官网实测（ra3xdh.github.io）——"Qucs with SPICE"，最新稳定版 **26.1.1**；发布节奏为 2024-02（24.1.0）→ 2024-03 → 2024-07 → 2024-10（24.4.0）→ 2025-02（25.1.0）→ 2025-09（25.2.0）→ **2026-04-09（26.1.0）**，近两年持续月度级更新。可调用后端：**Ngspice、Xyce、QucsatorRF、SpiceOpus**。支持论坛为 GitHub Discussions。其官网发表列表含多篇 2025-2026 期刊论文（MDPI Electronics/JLPEA 等 DOI 见来源清单），学术背书较新。
- **RF SoC 实战证据**：Patrick Fath《Towards a practical open source RF SoC design flow: Lessons from a 40 GHz tapeout in IHP SG13G2》（Zenodo，2026-07-06）摘要明确：流程基于 IIC-OSIC-TOOLS，**Xschem 画图 + ngspice/Xyce 仿真 + KLayout 版图**完成 40 GHz RF SoC 流片，且用 ngspice 做了**并行参数扫描与蒙特卡洛**；post-layout 指标：工作频率 0.15–44.7 GHz、灵敏度 −56 dBm、动态范围 62 dB（芯片已提交流片、尚未实测）。

**【推断/边界】** 上述证据表明「开源 SPICE + 开源 BiCMOS PDK 跑通 40 GHz 级模拟/射频电路」在 2026 年已是**已发生事实**。但 ngspice 是否原生支持谐波平衡（HB）/包络仿真等 RF 专用分析，**本次未读到一手文档页面，无法确认**——Fath 工作采用的是时域仿真 + 并行扫描路线，可作为保守参照。Verilog-A 支持状态（如 ngspice 的 OSDI 接口）同样未在本次来源中出现，**未确认**。

### 1.2 版图与 PDK

**【事实】**
- **IHP SG13G2（开源生态中射频支持最强的 PDK）**：GitHub 官方仓库实测——"130nm BiCMOS Open Source PDK, dedicated for Analog/Digital, Mixed Signal and **RF Design**"，**Apache 2.0** 许可，2023-03 起指向 SG13G2 节点，**2,212 commits / 168 forks**（2026-10-15）。官方文档（readthedocs）自述仍处 **preview/alpha**，"not intended to be used for production at this moment"。**注意：** 广泛流传的 HBT fT/fmax 具体数值（如 300/500 GHz 级）**未出现在我抓到的 README/文档首页中，未确认，请以 IHP 官方 PDK 文档为准**。
  - CHANGELOG（2026-09-01 未发布版，实测全文）显示 RF 支持正在快速补齐：**RF MOSFET PyCells、MoM 电容 PCell（cap_cmomf/cap_mom/cap_cmomi）、rfcmim、KLayout 电感金属栈可配置（#1068）、Magic LVS 电感识别（#873）、肖特基二极管 SBD、HBT 测试结构 GDS、AWS Palace 的 gds2palace 子模块（#1040，并注明兼容 scikit-rf 2.0）**、Xschem/KLayout PDK 集成、并行仿真脚本等。
- **SkyWater sky130 / GF180MCU**：IIC-OSIC-TOOLS（JKU Linz 维护的 Docker 一体化镜像，实测 README："all-in-one Docker/Podman container for open-source-based integrated circuit designs for analog and digital circuit flows"，基于 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS，AMD64/ARM64）开箱支持 **SKY130/GF180/IHP130** 三套 PDK。相对而言 sky130/GF180 的 PDK 定位为通用模拟/数字，RF 无源器件（电感/巴伦）模型与 IHP 的 SiGe BiCMOS 相比**明显更弱**（此为推断；sky130 RF 支持细节本次未单独核验）。
- **版图工具链**：Magic（opencircuitdesign.com/magic，Tim Edwards，实测可访问）、**KLayout**、**Xschem**、**OpenROAD/OpenROAD-flow-scripts/LibreLane**（均在 IHP README 的 supported EDA tools 链接中出现）；IHP PDK 的 KLayout 已支持 DRC/LVS/PCell 全流程（CHANGELOG 大量条目佐证）。
- **开源综合综述**：Baungarten-Leon《From RTL to Fabrication: Survey of Open-Source EDA Tools and PDKs》（MDPI Electronics，2026-03-02，OpenAlex 实测）可作系统参考文献。

### 1.3 电磁仿真

**【事实】**
- **openEMS**（GitHub thliebig/openEMS-Project，实测 README）：免费开源 **FDTD** 电磁场求解器，**Octave/Matlab 与 Python 双脚本接口**，3D 笛卡尔/柱坐标渐变网格、多线程+SIMD、Drude/Lorentz/Debye 色散材料、时/频域场输出（vtk/hdf5）；文档站 docs.openEMS.de。README 有 AGENTS.md/AI_POLICY.md，2026 年仍在活跃维护。**openems.de 主站本次多次抓取失败（404/拦截），仅 GitHub 镜像可信。**
- **AWS Palace（gds2palace）**：已作为子模块进入 IHP PDK（#1040），可用于**从 GDS 版图直接做 FEM 电磁提取**——这是开源流里少见的「版图→EM→S 参数」环节，且 CHANGELOG 特别注明与 scikit-rf 2.0 兼容。
- **MEEP、Elmer FEM**：本次检索未获取二者一手页面，**适用性未验证**（不展开）。

### 1.4 系统级 / 行为级：Python 生态

**【事实】**
- **scikit-rf**（readthedocs 实测）：BSD 许可的 RF/微波工程 Python 库，对象化 Network/S参数、**Circuit、校准、去嵌入、Q 因子、Vector Fitting（含参数化）、Virtual Instruments（仪器控制）**；引用列表显示 2026 年仍在持续被学术论文引用。
- **gdsfactory**：出现在 IHP PDK README（`gdsfactory.github.io/IHP/` 集成指南，CHANGELOG #691）与 IIC-OSIC-TOOLS 工具清单中——用于**参数化版图自动化（含光子/射频无源件）**。
- 你们的 Python 链路仿真（EVM/SEM/ACLR/PVT 蒙特卡洛）天然可与 scikit-rf（S 参数网络/匹配）+ Palace/openEMS（无源件 EM）+ KLayout Python API（版图脚本化）组成**闭环**：行为级模型参数可由晶体管级/EM 仿真结果回填。【推断】

### 1.5 商业工具免费/学术资源（对比参照）

**【事实/边界】** 仅确认 Keysight 官网可达（keysight.com / keysight.com.cn）；**ADS/Cadence/AWR 的具体学术授权条款、免费试用范围未在本次来源中核验**，不展开。建议通过学校 EDA 联盟渠道申请（此为常识性建议，属推断）。商业工具在谐波平衡/包络/DPD 闭环验证上的成熟度仍显著领先开源流——与 CSDN《开源EDA的能力边界》一文观点一致（该文称模拟/RF 前端仍依赖大量手工与专用工具；百度转引，正文未直读，作为**趋势佐证**引用）。

---

## 2. 社区

**【事实】**
- **国际**：
  - **GitHub 为核心阵地**：IHP-GmbH（IHP-Open-PDK）、iic-jku（IIC-OSIC-TOOLS）、ra3xdh（Qucs-S，Discussions 即支持论坛）、thliebig（openEMS）、TinyTapeout 组织。
  - **TinyTapeout Discord**（官网实测链接 discord.gg/qZHPrPsmt6）是当前最活跃的开源芯片新手社区之一。
  - ngspice 用户论坛在 SourceForge（sourceforge.net/p/ngspice/discussion/…，2026-10 当天有活动）。
  - **ORConf**：本次检索未获取 2024-2026 年会议一手页面，**最新届次信息未确认**。
- **中文**：
  - **GitLink 开源芯片社区**（gitlink.org.cn/zone/OSchip，实测可达）。
  - CSDN/知乎上有一批实践博客（如《IHP SG13G2开源PDK终极指南》2026-08、《开源EDA的能力边界》）；openatom 开源原子基金会有 openDACS 开源 EDA 分论坛活动记录（2023）。
  - **找 PDK/IP 的实际路径**（推断+事实）：PDK 直接用官方仓库（IHP/SkyWater/GF180 的 GitHub）；开源 IP 检索 GitHub topic（IHP README 指向 `topics/ihp`、`topics/open-source`、`topics/pdk`）；流片渠道见第 3 节。

---

## 3. 优秀实践：开源流做 RFIC 的真实案例

**【事实】**
1. **Patrick Fath，40 GHz RF SoC @ IHP SG13G2**（Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21508491，2026-07-06）：**目前公开可查、指标最完整的开源流 RFIC 流片案例**。完整流程=IIC-OSIC-TOOLS + Xschem + ngspice/Xyce + KLayout；含对数 RF 功率检测器（逐级检波对数视频放大器）；post-layout 0.15–44.7 GHz / −56 dBm / 62 dB。**作者明言：开源 RF-IC 生态最大缺口是「完全验证的自动寄生提取流程」**——这对你们 TX 设计是关键风险预告。
2. **TinyTapeout**（官网实测）：共享硅片平台，当前班车 **SKY26d / GF26c**（倒计时同天），提供 **IHP（Wokwi/Verilog）、SKY（Wokwi/Verilog/**Analog 模拟模板**）、GF 模板**；有价格计算器、往届 submitted chips 列表、Discord 支持；学术背书为 TechRxiv 论文《Tiny Tapeout: a shared silicon tapeout platform accessible to everyone》。**注意**：2025 年 Efabless 倒闭曾重创该项目（搜狐 2025 转述：chipIgnite 曾与 50 家学术机构合作、完成 80 项商业设计；TinyTapeout 承诺退款），**2025-08-28 宣布回归**（东方财富：改用基于 **LibreLane** 的定制流程做顶层复用器与数字后端）。RF 直接上 TinyTapeout 的公开案例**本次未找到**——SKY Analog 模板适合放大器类试验，但**电感/巴伦面积与 PAD 约束使完整射频前端难以塞进 tile**（推断）。
3. **开源 Wi-Fi 代表项目：openwifi**（GitHub open-sdr/openwifi，实测）：**SDR/FPGA 基带全栈** 802.11a/g/n（Wi-Fi 4），Linux mac80211 兼容，AGPLv3 双许可，支持 Xilinx Zynq + AD9361 平台，app note 明确 **70 MHz–6 GHz 频率范围**；有 w-iLab.t 测试床与公开论文列表。**定位澄清**：openwifi 是**基带+MAC 的 SDR 实现，不含 ASIC 射频**，可作为你们 TX 数字基带/行为级对拍参考，不是 RFIC 参考。【事实+澄清】
4. **IHP 官方生态信号**：bing_rss 抓到 2026-10-14 IHP 与智利 AC3E 宣布**三年开源半导体技术/工具/制造合作**（仅新闻索引，正文未读）——开源 RF 路线有官方持续投入。

**行为级+晶体管级混合验证最佳实践**（基于 Fath 案例+IIC-OSIC-TOOLS 能力归纳，属推断）：
- 数字控制/校准逻辑用 Verilog+cocotb（IIC-OSIC-TOOLS 含 cocotb）；模拟/RF 核心用 Xschem+ngspice（PVT 角+蒙特卡洛，ngspice 并行扫描已被 Fath 验证）；无源件用 Palace/openEMS 提取 S 参数后回灌 SPICE；行为级 Python 模型做系统级 EVM/SEM 闭环——与你们现有流程正好衔接。

---

## 4. Wi-Fi 7（802.11be）TX 射频业界进展（2024-2026）

**【事实——本次实际检索到的】**
- **关键 PHY 特性**（多源一致）：
  - **320 MHz 信道带宽、6 GHz 频段、4096-QAM、MLO（多链路操作）**：Qualcomm 官方 Wi-Fi 7 页面（320MHz/MLO/6GHz 文字实测可见）；OpenAlex 收录的 IEEE 综述（Deng et al. COMST 2020；Khorov et al. IEEE Access 2020；López-Raventós & Bellalta IEEE Wireless Commun. 2022 MLO 专文；García-Rodríguez IEEE Commun. Mag. 2021）摘要一致确认 4096-QAM/320MHz/MLO/multi-AP。
  - 中文侧资料（CSDN Wi-Fi 7 D3.0 解析、射频前端行业稿）同样以「6GHz+320MHz+4096-QAM+MLO」为四要素，并指出 **4096-QAM 对相位噪声/EVM 极为苛刻、320MHz 依赖连续信道**。
- **EVM 具体阈值**：4096-QAM 对应的 EVM 门限（通行说法约 −35 dB RMS）**未在本次任何来源原文中确认**——请以 IEEE 802.11be 标准文本/测试规范为准。百度文库一篇 WiFi7 测试稿提到「1 米视距、接收 −35 dBm、MCS13 PER<0.1%」（仅索引，未读正文），那是**接收侧测试条件，勿与 EVM 混用**。
- **国内生态**：康希通信（公众号稿，2026 上半年时点）称其 Wi-Fi 7 射频前端芯片已完成**博通/高通/联发科/瑞昱**四大主芯片平台参考设计认证——反映国内 RF-FEM 厂商已深度卡位 Wi-Fi 7。
- **学术前沿样本**：UC Irvine 140 GHz 120 Gbps CMOS 收发机报道（腾讯云开发者社区转述，速率为 Wi-Fi 7 的 4 倍）；Okada 实验室 DPLL 分数杂散抑制博士论文（OpenAlex，2024）。ISSCC 2024/2025 **具体 802.11be 论文标题与指标本次未能从公开渠道直接核验**（IEEE Xplore 检索被挡），**此处不列具体论文，避免凭印象编造**；检索 ISSCC 各届 program 摘要可确认 WLAN 收发机是常规 session 主题（OpenAlex 收录 RFIC/ISSCC program 页），但逐篇确认未完成。

**【推断——明确标注】** 基于上述公开资料与行业常识：Wi-Fi 7 主芯片 RF 趋势是**直接变频架构为主、数字辅助校准（DCO/DPLL）、DPD 用于高阶 QAM EVM 达标、6GHz+320MHz 推高 ADC/DAC 采样率与 PLL 带宽要求、MLO 要求双频段并发射频前端**。各家（高通/博通/联发科/MaxLinear）具体型号的架构细节与实测指标**未在本次来源中逐一确认**。

## 5. 落地建议（针对已完成 Python 行为级仿真的 Wi-Fi 7 TX ASIC 小组）

**推荐开源工具链组合**（全部经过本次实测存在且活跃）：

| 环节 | 工具 | 理由（事实依据） |
|---|---|---|
| 一体化环境 | **IIC-OSIC-TOOLS**（Docker） | 一键装齐 SKY130/GF180/IHP130 + 全套模拟工具，JKU 官方维护 |
| 工艺选择 | **IHP SG13G2** | 唯一明确面向 RF 的开源 BiCMOS PDK；RF 无源（电感/MoM/RF MOSFET PyCell）2026 年密集补齐；fT/fmax 请查其官方文档确认 |
| 原理图/仿真 | **Xschem + ngspice（+Xyce）** | Fath 40GHz 案例同款；支持并行蒙特卡洛 |
| 无源件 EM | **AWS Palace（gds2palace）→ scikit-rf** | PDK 官方集成、兼容 scikit-rf 2.0；电感/巴伦/匹配网络提取 |
| 备选 EM | **openEMS** | FDTD，Python 接口，适合天线/封装级 |
| 版图 | **KLayout（PCell/LVS/DRC）+ Magic** | IHP 官方支持链 |
| 系统闭环 | **scikit-rf + 你们现有 Python 栈** | S 参数/匹配/矢量拟合与行为级 EVM/SEM 模型互喂 |
| 流片 | **TinyTapeout（SKY26d/GF26c）或 IHP MPW 渠道** | TT 已从 Efabless 事件恢复并有 SKY Analog 模板；正式 RF 芯片走 IHP 官方 shuttle（注意 PDK 仍标 preview，量产需与 IHP 确认） |

**学习路径**（推断，但每步对应工具均已验证存在）：
1. 装 IIC-OSIC-TOOLS，跑通 IHP PDK 自带 Xschem+ngspice 示例（含标准单元 Qucs-S 原理图，CHANGELOG #939）。
2. 用 gds2palace 提取一个 PDK 自带电感 → scikit-rf 拟合 → 回灌 ngspice，验证「EM-电路」闭环。
3. 把你们 Python 行为级 TX 模型拆块：DAC/混频器/PA 驱动逐块晶体管化，块级指标由行为级模型反推（EVM 预算分配法）。
4. 关注 Fath 论文指出的**寄生提取缺口**：关键 RF 节点建议手工+Palace 双重提取互验。
5. 风险预案：PVT 蒙特卡洛结果与商业流对标时，注意开源 PDK 模型卡精度边界（IHP 官方自述 preview 状态）。

氮化镓(GaN)半导体核心优势：
- 宽禁带（3.4 eV，远超硅1.1eV和砷化镓1.4eV）→ 高击穿电压、高工作温度、抗辐射
- 高热导率（1.3 W/cm·K）→ 优异散热性能
- 高电子饱和漂移速度 + 高电子迁移率 → 高频、高速开关性能，适合射频/微波器件
- 化学稳定性极好（几乎不被任何酸腐蚀）→ 恶劣环境可靠工作
- 强压电性和自发极化 → AlGaN/GaN异质结界面可产生极高密度2DEG（10^13/cm²，比GaAs系高一个数量级）
- 低导通电阻 + 高功率密度 → 器件可做得更小更高效
被誉为"第三代半导体材料"（第一代Ge/Si，第二代GaAs/InP）

阿雷西博信息（Arecibo Message）是1974年11月16日从波多黎各阿雷西博天文台发送的星际无线电信息。由Frank Drake设计，Carl Sagan等人参与。信息由1679个二进制位组成，1679=23×73（两个素数的乘积，即半素数），这是精心选择的——接收者只有将比特排列成73行×23列才能看到有意义的图像。信息发向武仙座球状星团M13，距离约25,000光年。包含7个部分：1）数字1-10的二进制表示；2）构成DNA的5种元素的原子序数（H=1, C=6, N=7, O=8, P=15）；3）核苷酸化学式（脱氧核糖和4种碱基）；4）DNA双螺旋结构+核苷酸对数量（约43亿）；5）人类形象+当时全球人口（约42.9亿）+平均身高（用发射波长12.6cm为单位）；6）太阳系示意图，地球被偏移高亮标示为发信来源；7）阿雷西博望远镜+直径（2430×12.6cm≈306m）。发射频率2380MHz，波长12.6cm。

氮化镓(GaN)半导体核心优势：
- 宽禁带（3.4 eV，远超硅1.1eV和砷化镓1.4eV）→ 高击穿电压、高工作温度、抗辐射
- 高热导率（1.3 W/cm·K）→ 优异散热性能
- 高电子饱和漂移速度 + 高电子迁移率 → 高频、高速开关性能，适合射频/微波器件
- 化学稳定性极好（几乎不被任何酸腐蚀）→ 恶劣环境可靠工作
- 强压电性和自发极化 → AlGaN/GaN异质结界面可产生极高密度2DEG（10^13/cm²，比GaAs系高一个数量级）
- 低导通电阻 + 高功率密度 → 器件可做得更小更高效
被誉为"第三代半导体材料"（第一代Ge/Si，第二代GaAs/InP）
应用领域：蓝/绿光LED、激光二极管、5G基站射频功放、功率转换器（充电器/EV逆变器）、紫外探测器、传感器

- npl=8: 76 tok/s

results.title: A Fully Integrated High Linearity CMOS Dual-Band Power Amplifier for WLAN Applications in 55-Nm CMOS
results.abstract: This paper presents a dual-band fully integrated high linearity CMOS power amplifier (PA). The PA employs a reconfigurable transformer in the input matching network to achieve low reflection coefficient across both bands, demonstrating significant flexibility in the design of dual-band power amplifiers with high output powers. Additionally, a detailed design methodology for the dual-band matching network is introduced. By utilizing this methodology, the PA has been designed using 55 nm CMOS technology. For continuous-wave operation, the PA achieves a saturated power (Psat) of 28.03 dBm and 27.5–28.2 dBm, with power-added efficiency (PAE) of 33.2% and 24.6–31.1%, in the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz WLAN bands, respectively. Concurrently, the PA power cells, which employ multi-gate transistor (MGTR) technology, achieve an intermodulation distortion (IMD3) of below 30 dBc at an output power of 15 dBm in both the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz WLAN bands. The proposed PA outperforms other dual-band or multi-band PAs in terms of output power and exhibits great potential for WLAN applications.

results.title: IEEE 802.11be: Wi-Fi 7 Strikes Back
results.abstract: As hordes of data-hungry devices challenge its current capabilities, Wi-Fi strikes back with 802.11be, alias Wi-Fi 7. This brand new amendment promises a (r)evolution of unlicensed wireless connectivity as we know it. To appreciate its foreseen impact, we start by overviewing the latest Wi-Fi-related news, with emphasis on the recently launched Wi-Fi 6E certification program. We then provide an updated digest of 802.11be essential features, vouching for multi-AP coordination as a must-have for critical and latency-sensitive applications. We finally get down to the nitty-gritty of one of its most enticing implementations - coordinated beamforming - for which our standard-compliant simulations confirm near-tenfold reductions in worst case delays.

results.title: IEEE 802.11be Wi-Fi 7: New Challenges and Opportunities
results.abstract: With the emergence of 4k/8k video, the throughput requirement of video delivery will keep grow to tens of Gbps. Other new high-throughput and low-latency video applications including augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), and online gaming, are also proliferating. Due to the related stringent requirements, supporting these applications over wireless local area network (WLAN) is far beyond the capabilities of the new WLAN standard - IEEE 802.11ax. To meet these emerging demands, the IEEE 802.11 will release a new amendment standard IEEE 802.11be - Extremely High Throughput (EHT), also known as Wireless-Fidelity (Wi-Fi) 7. This article provides the comprehensive survey on the key medium access control (MAC) layer techniques and physical layer (PHY) techniques being discussed in the EHT task group, including the channelization and tone plan, multiple resource units (multi-RU) support, 4096 quadrature amplitude modulation (4096-QAM), preamble designs, multiple link operations (e.g., multi-link aggregation and channel access), multiple input multiple output (MIMO) enhancement, multiple access point (multi-AP) coordination (e.g., multi-AP joint transmission), enhanced link adaptation and retransmission protocols (e.g., hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ)). This survey covers both the critical technologies being discussed in EHT standard and the related latest progresses from worldwide research. Besides, the potential developments beyond EHT are discussed to provide some possible future research directions for WLAN.

results.title: Current Status and Directions of IEEE 802.11be, the Future Wi-Fi 7
results.abstract: While customers rivet their eyes on Wi-Fi 6, in the bowels of the IEEE 802.11 Working Group that creates Wi-Fi standards, the next generation Wi-Fi is being developed. At the very first sight, the new IEEE 802.11be amendment to the Wi-Fi standard is nothing but scaled 11ax with doubled bandwidth and the increased number of spatial streams, which together provide data rates as high as 40 Gbps. A bit deeper dive into the 802.11 activities reveals that 11be will support real-time applications. In reality, 11be introduces many more revolutionary changes to Wi-Fi, which will form a basement for further Wi-Fi evolution. Although by now (May 2020), the development process is at the very early phase without any draft specification, the analysis of the discussion in the 802.11 Working Group gives insights into the main innovations of 11be. In addition to the ones above, they include native multi-link operation, channel sounding optimization that opens the door for massive MIMO, advanced PHY and MAC techniques, the cooperation of various access points. The paper analyzes hundreds of features proposed for the new technology, focusing on the open problems that can be solved by the researchers who want to contribute to the development of 802.11be.

results.title: Multi-Link Operation in IEEE 802.11be WLANs
results.abstract: The multi-link operation (MLO) is a new feature proposed to be part of the IEEE 802.11be Extremely High Throughput (EHT) amendment. Such feature represents a paradigm shift towards multi-link communications, as nodes will be allowed to transmit and receive data over multiple radio interfaces concurrently. To make it possible, the 802.11be Task Group has proposed different modifications in regards to nodes' architecture, transmission operation, and management functionalities. This article reviews such changes and tackles the question of how traffic should be distributed over multiple links, as it is still unresolved. results.abstract: Innovation and evolution are paramount where the demand for wideband, data-intensive connectivity is ever-increasing, and the only constant is change. Standards that define the operation of next-generation mobile networks are moving away from the traditional radio frequency (RF) spectrum and into millimeter-wave (mm-wave) bands. The physical layer (PHY) for IEEE 802.11ad Wi-Fi and 802.11ay WLANs dictates operation in the unlicensed 60 GHz band. 5G New Radio (NR) applications utilize selected bands from 26 to 39 GHz. Additionally, newly developing Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR) applications depend on 5G NR as an enabling technology. Satellite communications and wireless backhaul will occur in E-band between 70–86 GHz. Increasing demands from the market cause designers to push boundaries, and the development of standards guide technological advances. Perhaps the most substantial improvements are observed in integrated circuit technology. This article details the major Si processes, namely Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) and SiGe Bipolar CMOS (BiCMOS), and their foray into the wireless transceiver space traditionally dominated by GaAs. CMOS and BiCMOS have become popular in many communities because of their low fabrication cost and excellent digital integration capabilities. RF performance has matured to where Si is a serious competitor for tried-and-tested III-V technologies. Some extreme environments and sophisticated applications still favor GaAs and GaN, however. GaAs, for example, can yield unparalleled output power and excellent noise figure performance, albeit at a higher cost and increased design and manufacturing complexity due to the multi-chip nature of these circuits.

results.abstract: The continuous growth in mobile data traffic and limited license wireless spectrum have led to dramatically increase the demand of the radio spectrum. It is widespread the concern about the coexistence of long term evolution (LTE) and Wi-Fi in the unlicensed band. There are several techniques have been proposed to enable the coexistence of LTE and Wi-Fi in the unlicensed band, but these works are targeted on the impact of the LTE to the Wi-Fi network performance. An experiment is carried out in this work to evaluate the impact of Wi-Fi signal on the video streaming in the LTE network. The experimental test comprised of the national instrument (NI) universal software radio peripheral (USRP) 2953R that is controlled by the LabVIEW Communication LTE application framework. Extensiveexperiments are carried out under two scenarios, i.e. (1) Coexistence of LTE and Wi-Fi signal, (2) LTE signal only. Performance evaluations are carried out with different Modulation and coding schemes (MCS) values and different mode of operations, i.e. frequency division duplex (FDD) and time division duplex (TDD) mode. The results illustrated that the interference from Wi-Fi signal caused the performance degradation of the LTE network in throughput and the power received by user equipment (UE).

results.title: Towards a practical open source RF SoC design flow: Lessons from a 40 GHz tapeout in IHP SG13G2
results.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
results.abstract: This presentation reports practical lessons from the design and tapeout of a 40-GHz RF system-on-chip in the open-source IHP SG13G2 130-nm SiGe BiCMOS technology. The design flow is based on IIC-OSIC-TOOLS and uses Xschem for schematic capture, ngspice and Xyce for circuit simulation, and KLayout for physical implementation. The RF-SoC contains a logarithmic RF power detector based on a successive-detection logarithmic video amplifier. The presentation discusses PDK verification and model corrections, device operating-point annotation, parallel ngspice parameter-sweep and Monte Carlo simulations, KLayout productivity improvements, padframe extensions, top-level padframe simulation, and post-layout verification. Post-layout simulations indicate an operating-frequency range of 0.15–44.7 GHz, a sensitivity of −56 dBm, and a dynamic range of 62 dB. The work also identifies the lack of a fully verified automated parasitic-extraction flow as a major remaining gap in the open-source RF-IC design ecosystem. At the time of the presentation, the chip had been submitted for fabrication but had not yet been measured; the reported performance is therefore based on post-layout simulations.

results.title: Design of Differential Variable-Gain Transimpedance Amplifier in 0.18 µm SiGe BiCMOS
results.abstract: This paper presents two new inductorless differential variable-gain transimpedance amplifiers (DVGTIA) with voltage bias controlled variable gain designed in TowerJazz’s 0.18 µm SiGe BiCMOS technology (using CMOS transistors only). Both consist of a modified differential cross-coupled regulated cascode preamplifier stage and a cascaded amplifier stage with bias-controlled gain-variation and third-order interleaving feedback. The designs have wide measured transimpedance gain ranges of 24.5–60.6 dBΩ and 27.8–62.8 dBΩ with bandwidth above 6.42 GHz and 5.22 GHz for DVGTIA designs 1 and 2 respectively. The core power consumptions are 30.7 mW and 27.5 mW from a 1.8 V supply and the input referred noise currents are 10.3 pA/√Hz and 21.7 pA/√Hz. The DVGTIA designs 1 and 2 have a dynamic range of 40.4 µA to 3 mA and 76.8 µA to 2.7 mA making both suitable for real photodetectors with an on-chip photodetector capacitive load of 250 fF. Both designs are compact with a core area of 100 µm × 85 µm.

results.title: From RTL to Fabrication: Survey of Open-Source EDA Tools and PDKs
results.abstract: This article aims to synthesize the current ecosystem of open-source tools for Integrated Circuit (IC) design, covering the entire digital design flow from Register-Transfer Level (RTL) description to fabricable layouts. The survey categorizes and analyzes tools across major stages of design, including code-generation tools, logic synthesis, simulation, and physical design flow. Special emphasis is given to the fabricable open-source Process Design Kit (PDK), which enables the physical realization of open-hardware projects. By examining interoperability, limitations, and maturity across this toolchain, the article provides a comprehensive overview of the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) landscape and identifies the research and educational opportunities that arise from democratizing silicon design through open and reproducible workflows.

results.title: High Power Millimeter-Wave Signal Generation in Advanced SiGe and CMOS Process
results.abstract: This thesis first presents a fully-integrated 16-way power combining amplifier for 67-92 GHz applications in an advanced 90 nm silicon germanium (SiGe) HBT technology. The 16-way amplifier is implemented using 3-stage common-emitter single-ended power amplifiers (PAs) as building blocks, and reactive l/4 impedance transformation networks are used for power combining. The 3-stage single PA breakout has a small-signal gain of 22 dB at 74 GHz, and saturation output power (Psat ) of 14.3-16.4 dBm at 68-99 GHz. The power-combining PA achieves a small-signal gain of 19.3 dB at 74 GHz, and Psat of 25.3-27.3 dBm at 68-88 GHz with a maximum power added efficiency (PAE) of 12.4%. The 16-way amplifier occupies 6.48 mm2 (including pads) and consumes a maximum current of 2.1 A from a 1.8 V supply. To our knowledge, this is the highest power silicon-based E-band amplifier to-date.Next, a fully-integrated 8-way power combining amplifier for 110-134 GHz applications in an advanced 90 nm silicon germanium (SiGe) HBT technology is presented. The 8-way amplifier is implemented using 4-stage common-emitter single-ended power amplifiers (PAs) as building blocks, and reactive l/4 impedance transformation networks are used for power combining. The single-ended PA breakout has a small-signal gain of 20 dB at 116 GHz, and saturation output power (Psat ) of 12.5-13.8 dBm at 114-130 GHz. The 8-way power combining PA achieves a small-signal gain of 15 dB at 116 GHz, and Psat of 20-20.8 dBm at 114-126 GHz with a power added efficiency (PAE) of 7.6-6.3%. The 8-way amplifier occupies 4.95 mm2 (including pads) and consumes a maximum current of 980 mA from a 1.6 V supply. To our knowledge, this is the highest power silicon-based D-band amplifier to-date.Next, a fully-integrated 4-way power combining multiplier for 200-230 GHz applications in an advanced 90 nm silicon germanium (SiGe) HBT technology is presented. The 4-way combined multiplier is implemented using active balanced transistor pairs with device size of 460.1 μm2 with 4-stage pseudo-differential driver power amplifiers (PAs) as building blocks, and reactive l/4 impedance transformation networks are used for power combining. The 4-stage single-ended PA breakout has a peak small-signal gain of 19.3 dB at 110 GHz, and a saturation output power (Psat ) of 14.5 dBm at 116 GHz. The multiplier breakout results in a peak output power of 1.8 dBm at 245 GHz with a peak conversion gain of -15.5 dB. The power-combining multiplier achieves a peak output power of 8 dBm at 215 GHz with an associate conversion gain of -4.7 dB and the peak conversion gain is 1.6 dB at 215 GHz. The 4-way combined multiplier occupies 3.63 mm2 (including pads) and consumes a maximum current of 1.2 A from a 1.8 V supply. To our knowledge, this work generates the highest power among the silicon-based technology to-date at frequency above 200 GHz.Finally, high-power stand-alone millimeter-wave frequency multipliers in advanced SiGe and CMOS process are presented. First, a 135-160 GHz active doubler has been developed in 45 nm CMOS SOI. Careful optimization is done on the transistor size, layout and transmission-lines in order to result in the best performance. The doubler shows a measured peak power of +3.5 dBm at 150 GHz and > 2 dBm at 140-160 GHz, at a bias voltage of 1 V. These were achieved at an input power of 7-8 dBm at 70-80 GHz, resulting in a conversion gain of -4 to -5 dBm. To our knowledge, these are the best results achieved for a D-band doubler in SiGe or CMOS, and shows that advanced CMOS technology can be used to generate wideband power above 100 GHz. Second, a wideband 90 nm SiGe BiCMOS frequency multiplier at 200-245 GHz is presented. The balanced multiplier results in a low first harmonic component, and uses a reflector at the base nodes to reflect the second harmonics to transistors for improved efficiency. The measured output power is > -2 dBm at 200-245 GHz with a peak value of +2 dBm at 224-228 GHz and a conversion gain of -15 dB. To the author’s knowledge, this is the highest power wideband doubler at 200-250 GHz.
